$comment: Warning waivers per the HIVE brief: each records owner, reason, expiry, and retest. scripts/audit-gate.mjs enforces expiry so waived findings resurface.

waivers.reason: Build-time image parsing inside Metro (expo dev chain). DoS-only (infinite loop on crafted ICNS); no confidentiality impact; all images parsed at build time are repo-controlled generated PNGs. No fixed version is published on npm (latest is 2.0.2, advisory covers <=2.0.2).
waivers.retest: Re-run npm audit at every dependency refresh; remove this waiver as soon as a fixed image-size release ships.

waivers.reason: Same component and exposure as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr (JXL/HEIF parser infinite loops). Build-time only; repo-controlled inputs; no fixed version published.
waivers.retest: Re-run npm audit at every dependency refresh; remove this waiver as soon as a fixed image-size release ships.
